name: india_pre_ist
verified_against: Independent reimplementation (tests/astrology/independent.py): UTC offset from the IANA database via zoneinfo, Julian Day per Meeus ch.7, ascendant by spherical trigonometry per Meeus ch.12/22 — agreeing within 0.25 arcmin and 0.01s. This fixture is a synthetic probe, not a real birth, so no hand-cast kundali exists for it or can; what it asserts is Asia/Kolkata at +5:21:10, Madras Mean Time before 1906, and that is what was independently confirmed. Planetary longitudes are not independently confirmed here — they rest on test_invariants.py and the hand-cast graha sphuta table in test_textbook.py. Re-frozen unchanged at engine 0.6.1: the Moon epicycle correction is inside Surya Siddhanta and this fixture is drik, so every value here is byte-identical to 0.6.0 and only the version stamp moved. Engine 0.7.0: the samvatsara now follows Jupiter (surya.barhaspatya_year) instead of a fixed offset from the Shaka year. Nothing else in this chart moved.
why: Kolkata was on Madras Mean Time (+5:21:10) before 1906.
